title: safe_divide missing zero edge case
description: safe_divide should return 0 when the denominator is 0, but it does not guard against it and raises ZeroDivisionError.

files.divide.py:
def safe_divide(a, b):
    return a / b

hidden_tests.test_divide.py:
from divide import safe_divide


def test_divide():
    assert safe_divide(10, 2) == 5
    assert safe_divide(7, 0) == 0
    assert safe_divide(0, 5) == 0
